name: Figures at a foodstall, Macau, with houses beyond
summary: A stooping figure beneath a straw sunshade serves food to his customers, who hold bowls up to their mouths; a barber attends to his client on the left.  client on the left.  This Macau street market, often sketched by Chinnery, was located close to the railings of the church of S. Domingos: compare
